title: Antagonising explanation and revealing bias directly through sequencing and multimodal inference

bias_targets.methodology: Generating video sequences through text-guided image diffusion models (using virtual timelines and parameter sequencing) to expose how the models reconstruct reality and visual culture based on the temporally specific records in their training datasets.
Analyzing the outputs of guided diffusion models across continuous frames to reveal the specific cultural and historical markings embedded in the network's learned representations.
